opening.text: I've been tired all the time, and it just doesn't go away. I've been sleeping poorly, and I've been losing weight without trying. My skin has turned yellow. In the last few months I switched to a vegetarian diet to try to get my energy back up. I smoke a pack of cigarettes a day, and I have 5 alcoholic drinks a day.
